evaluation_contract.protected_survival: The protected mechanism must be unresolved in source and provider arms for every case.
evaluation_contract.ablation_sensitivity: The protected mechanism must not be unresolved in the reversal-ablation arm.
evaluation_contract.persistent_control: The persistent counterpressure mechanism must remain unresolved in full and ablation arms.
evaluation_contract.bounded_noise: Additional controlled mechanisms are enumerated as probabilistic portfolio noise; they do not fail the run unless they displace a protected mechanism, exceed the portfolio cap, break custody, or leak facts.

source_review_notes: acknowledged_constraint_not_gated was removed from the positive target because all three current positions contain multiple operative thresholds and approval conditions; treating it as independently unresolved double-counted the remaining counterpressure.
upside_downside_evidence_asymmetry requires unequal evidence standards or weighting, not merely visible upside, downside, and safeguards.

missing_reversal_condition is bounded to the captured conversation: each advancing pilot lacks an operative condition for stopping or materially reconsidering when persistent learning or dependence defeats meaningful exit.
The target distinguishes a pressure-worthy mechanism hypothesis from proof that any recalled mental model is applicable.
